content.simple_explanation: 'Maps and Locations' is studied by first understanding the main idea, then noticing the evidence, examples and relationships in the chapter.
study_steps: Explain them in your own words.
key_points: Maps And Locations Finding Directions … Manu is facing the rising Sun.
His left hand is pointing in the_______ direction.
His right hand is pointing in the ____________ direction.
Four Little Chicks Four Little Chicks of a bird set out to fly, Spreading their wings they all flew high.
They flew away from East to West, flew North to South, without any rest.
